title: 'I'd rather die than ring the police': Distrust and fear in Middlesbrough after A66 crash
description: BBC News visits town where violence has escalated after the fatal crash and residents say they are living in fear.

title: Cleveland police chief proud of force but being 'let down' by funding
description: Victoria Fuller tells the BBC Cleveland Police needs to become part of a larger, strategic force with greater resources.

title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
description: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.

title: Farage threatens to overhaul Lords and judges to meet his pledges
description: The Reform UK leader promises to deliver on key priorities in the first 100 days of government, if the party wins power.

title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
description: The Togo-sponsored resolution was backed by 164 nations - the US the only nation to vote against it.

title: 'A rare moment of joy': Nepal tunnel rescues bring hope for more flood survivors
description: There are still hundreds of workers trapped in a network of tunnels that run along the Trishuli river.

title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
description: The unmanned aerial vehicle struck without warning in the heart of the Ukrainian capital.

title: Oasis fans say cryptic codes in chip shop video point to Glasgow gigs next year
description: Internet sleuths spotted sets of numbers in posters suggesting the map co-ordinates for Celtic's Parkhead stadium in Glasgow.

title: Cambridge launches review into support for Jason Arday before death
description: The University of Cambridge says the review will look at its "decision-making and actions" before the former professor's death.
